sentences.text: 贬值后进口总值会立即上升，而出口大体不变，部分原因是既有贸易合同必须履行。
sentences.evidence: Immediately following the depreciation or devaluation of the currency, the total value of imports will increase and exports remain largely unchanged due in part to pre-existing trade contracts that have to be honored.

sentences.text: 同理，若本币升值，则会出现倒J形曲线。
sentences.evidence: Likewise, if there is a currency revaluation or appreciation the same reasoning may be applied and will lead to an inverted J curve.

sentences.text: 对J曲线的实证研究有时关注汇率变动对贸易比率（出口除以进口）的影响，而非贸易差额本身。
sentences.evidence: Empirical investigations of the J curve have sometimes focused on the effect of exchange rate changes on the trade ratio, i.e. exports divided by imports
